purpose: Run one frozen external-corpus diagnostic now, before further treatment repair, to determine whether the current R0-delta heads have observable causal value outside the tiny hand-curated development panels and whether the current Function instrument is too insensitive to serve as a first-version hard gate.

sequencing_override.pi_direction: Prefer one actual external-corpus test over another open-ended internal repair loop.
sequencing_override.overrides_only: The prior prohibition on any external execution before treatment qualification is relaxed for this single exploratory diagnostic.
does_not_override: formal external confirmation still requires qualified selectors and the full named baseline matrix
consumed external-corpus diagnostic outcomes may not be used as untouched confirmatory evidence
no post-outcome sample deletion, threshold change, arm change, or judge-rubric change
the primary paper claim remains RS_pass AND count_pass(MP,MS,ME) >= 2

measurement_validity_correction.problem: Natural-language Function is a latent and only partially identifiable construct. Even a source-aware human or strong LLM may be unable to prove that a wording change could only have come from one memory, and inter-rater disagreement does not by itself imply that the treatment had no causal effect.
measurement_validity_correction.primary_estimand: Same-state, same-seed deployment intention-to-treat contrast: does adding or removing one authorized component change blind response Quality, source-aware Risk, and measured Cost?
evidence_hierarchy: Primary: randomized same-state Quality, Risk, and Cost contrasts.
Structural manipulation check: requested-to-received accounting, owner/time validity, exact prompt exposure, and leakage guards.
Secondary mechanism evidence: blind source-aware Function (CLEAR/PLAUSIBLE/NONE/UNCERTAIN), never generator self-report.
Objective triangulation: ES-MemEval Token F1/BERTScore/retrieval/abstention for memory QA, where Function is not inferred from prose style.

first_version_interpretation.quality_positive_risk_safe_function_none: Do not automatically declare the head ineffective. Record a positive causal treatment result with unresolved mechanism attribution; test whether Function has low sensitivity or whether prompt structure rather than source content caused the gain.
first_version_interpretation.quality_nonpositive_function_none: The treatment/candidate interface is probably ineffective on this slice; Function-instrument weakness cannot rescue absent outcome value.
first_version_interpretation.function_positive_quality_nonpositive: The resource is observably used but does not create product value; the head does not qualify.
first_version_interpretation.quality_positive_risk_safe_function_posi: Strongest evidence that the component contributes useful, attributable value.

measurement_validity_correction.formal_head_pass_note: This diagnostic does not silently rewrite the already-frozen formal head-pass contract. It tests whether that contract's Function subgate should later be treated as supporting mechanism evidence rather than an absolute first-version veto.

scope.externality_label: development-informed external-corpus diagnostic, not pristine or untouched external confirmation
scope.population: Exactly one previously ungenerated state per each of the 18 EvoEmo owners, selected without reading any response outcome.
scope.opportunity_enrichment: Every selected state must have learned RS ON, learned MS ON, and a structurally eligible MP Rank-1. This estimates treatment capacity and component marginal effects on an opportunity slice, not natural-distribution policy value.

routing_and_candidate_policy.RS: Frozen 2026-08-01 learned opportunity checkpoint at threshold 0.5, followed by frozen 79-card V4 retrieval.
routing_and_candidate_policy.MS: Frozen source-annotated consensus full-fit checkpoint plus frozen outer-train abstention on_min; ON is compiled as pre-decided USE, while OFF/UNCERTAIN would be physically absent. Only ON states enter this enriched slice.
routing_and_candidate_policy.MP: No qualified learned selector exists. MP is therefore explicitly a fixed-eligible Rank-1 treatment in this diagnostic and must not be called learned PM.
routing_and_candidate_policy.joint_system_label: hybrid treatment-capacity stress test (learned RS + learned MS + fixed-eligible MP), not a qualified learned four-head policy

planned_measurement.quality: Blind paired full versus always_off and full versus each minus-component arm, clustered by owner.
planned_measurement.risk: Source-aware absolute six-dimension review for every physical reply; compare full with always_off and with every minus-component arm.
planned_measurement.cost: Actual input/output tokens, retries, latency and USD for every arm; deterministic injected-resource cost reported separately.
planned_measurement.function: Secondary blind source-aware audit on a frozen stratified subset per component; it explains mechanism but cannot erase a favorable primary ITT result by itself.
planned_measurement.statistics: Report all 18 owner-level paired directions and uncertainty. This enriched diagnostic uses directional evidence and effect sizes; it is not powered or labeled as final confirmatory significance.

decision_table.proceed_to_one_bounded_selector_or_inter: At least one memory component shows positive Quality direction versus its minus arm with no material/critical Risk increase, or the full system improves Quality versus always-off safely.
decision_table.measurement_repair_priority: Primary ITT is positive and safe while Function is predominantly NONE/UNCERTAIN.
decision_table.treatment_repair_priority: Primary ITT is nonpositive and Function is absent, or Function is present but Quality is nonpositive.
decision_table.stop_open_ended_internal_loop: No head shows positive safe marginal direction and the full system does not beat always-off; report the negative current-generator result before considering a generator factor experiment.

three_external_track_context.ESConv: Existing current-RS external result remains real negative evidence; no duplicate run is needed merely to call this diagnostic external.
three_external_track_context.EvoEmo: This new run is the current-V4 treatment-capacity diagnostic for RS/MP/MS interaction and marginal effects.
three_external_track_context.ES_MemEval: Existing V5.2 2090-outcome objective QA result remains historical-version triangulation only; a current learned-PM QA run is not scientifically available until a deployable MP selector and a current QA routing adapter exist.

authorization.next: Materialize an exact content-addressed 18-state/90-call proposal, then obtain explicit identity and cost-cap approval.
